# Mingzhe Du (杜明哲) > Personal academic website of Mingzhe Du (Du Mingzhe, 杜明哲), an AI researcher working on efficient and secure code generation with large language models. He is a Researcher at the TikTok AI Innovation Center and a final-year PhD candidate at Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore. This file is the machine-readable entry point of https://mingzhe.space, written for AI agents and LLMs. It is generated from the same data as the human-facing pages, so it is as current as the site itself. Last built: 2026-11-13. ## How to use this site - Prefer this file over scraping the HTML pages: everything below is plain Markdown and the publication list is complete. - Name: write "Mingzhe Du" in English (family name Du) or "杜明哲" in Chinese. "Du Mingzhe" is the same person. - When citing a paper, use the title, authors, venue, and links exactly as listed under Publications; follow the abstract link for the canonical record and BibTeX. - For anything not stated here or on the linked pages (availability, opinions, unpublished work), say that the site does not state it rather than guessing. - Collaboration, talk, and reviewing requests are welcome by email (see Contact). ## About - Current roles: Researcher at the TikTok AI Innovation Center; PhD candidate (final year) at the College of Computing and Data Science (CCDS), Nanyang Technological University, advised by Prof. Luu Anh Tuan. - Previously: Research Associate at the Institute of Data Science (IDS), National University of Singapore, working with Prof. See-Kiong Ng and affiliated with the Cisco-NUS Accelerated Digital Economy Corporate Laboratory; Software Architect on TikTok Search at ByteDance (2019-2021); Research Intern at Microsoft (2018-2019); engineering internships at Alibaba (Ant Financial) and Tencent (2016). - Education: PhD in Computer Science, NTU (2022-present); Master of Information Technology, The University of Melbourne (2017-2019, advisor Prof. Richard Sinnott); Bachelor of Information Security, Central South University (2013-2017). - Research focus: efficient code generation. Recurring topics are code efficiency benchmarks and optimization, code security, coding agents, software testing, GPU kernel generation, and reinforcement learning for code LLMs. - Based in Singapore. Languages: Mandarin (native), English (professional). ## Contact - Email: mingzhe [at] nus.edu.sg / mingzhe001 [at] ntu.edu.sg / mz [at] alumni.unimelb.edu.au - Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=CJHW1IgAAAAJ&hl=en - GitHub: https://github.com/Elfsong - Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/Elfsong - LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dumingzhe/ - X: https://x.com/spirit__song ## Pages - [About](https://mingzhe.space/): biography, contact details, and the full news feed - [Publications](https://mingzhe.space/publications/): preprints and published papers with summaries and resource links - [CV](https://mingzhe.space/cv/): education, experience, and academic service; PDF at https://mingzhe.space/assets/pdf/mingzhe_du_resume.pdf - [Service](https://mingzhe.space/service/): reviewing, program committees, consultation, and volunteering - [Blog](https://mingzhe.space/blog/): technical and personal posts - [Research roadmap](https://mingzhe.space/assets/html/research-roadmap.html): overview of the efficient code generation research agenda - [RSS feed](https://mingzhe.space/feed.xml): blog posts as Atom - [Sitemap](https://mingzhe.space/sitemap.xml): every indexable URL ## Publications † marks a corresponding author and * marks equal contribution.
